verse: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
story: John's Gospel makes its boldest claim in a handful of words: the One who was with God from the beginning became one of us.

The Word took on flesh, a real body that could hunger and tire, and made His dwelling among us. The verb recalls the tabernacle, where God once lived in a tent among His people. John says we have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father. It was full of grace and truth. The unseen God has made Himself known in a person.
Christmas Day is not about a distant God. He came close enough to be seen and touched. Welcome Him.
theme: Christmas Day: the Word made flesh
